results.title: Computational Morita equivalence with unrestricted radicals
results.question: Determine the complexity of recognizing Morita equivalence between arbitrary finite-dimensional finite-field algebras given by structure constants, with explicit equivalence bimodules when they exist.
results.result: TI-complete Morita equivalence, with explicit equivalence bimodules and fixed-field deterministic reductions.

results.title: Unitary tensor equivalence over finite local rings
results.question: Develop P18-type average-case algorithms over unramified quadratic extensions of Z/p^eZ, including p=2, with explicit Hermitian transporter recovery.
results.result: Unitary P18-type average-case recovery over quadratic unramified local rings, including residue characteristic two.

results.title: Random symmetric cubic orthogonal equivalence
results.question: Give an almost-all polynomial-time exact algorithm for orthogonal equivalence of uniformly sampled symmetric cubic tensors, where repeated-coordinate dependencies invalidate iid 3-tensor arguments.
results.result: Deterministic diagonal orthogonal isomorphism for almost every uniform symmetric cubic source over every finite field.

results.title: Geometric orbit versus rational orbit at random sources
results.question: For a specified uniform finite-field tensor ensemble, quantify the probability that geometric GL equivalence splits into several base-field orbits and exploit this in an average algorithm.
results.result: Exact geometric-to-rational orbit collision probability and factoring-free recognition of an étale tensor ensemble.

results.title: Arbitrary bilinear-form stabilizers
results.question: Classify the complexity of tensor orbit decision under groups preserving supplied nonsymmetric bilinear forms, including nonsemisimple asymmetry operators.
results.result: TI completeness for nonsymmetric forms with nonsemisimple asymmetry, including the two smallest fields.

results.title: Intrinsic decomposition of indecomposable matrix spaces
results.question: Construct a polynomial-time canonical decomposition of arbitrary matrix spaces under left-right direct sums, with a precise uniqueness theorem supporting transporter recovery.
results.result: Intrinsic independent direct-sum decomposition via centroids, with transporter assembly and squarefree-factorization hardness.

results.title: Unipotent network orbits with nontrivial brackets
results.question: Find polynomial-time orbit algorithms for P18 coefficient networks acted on by growing two-step unipotent groups whose commutator maps are explicitly supplied.
results.result: Polynomial-time transporter, stabilizer and count for explicitly represented finite-field unipotent actions.

results.title: Canonical radical filtration for tensor residual actions
results.question: Construct polynomial-time invariant filtrations that reduce tensor transporter recovery over arbitrary nilpotent residual algebras to polynomially many linear orbit problems.
results.result: Canonical residual-algebra filtrations and exact linear lifting in the source group.

results.title: Matroid isomorphism from rank oracle queries
results.question: Find a polynomial-query algorithm or a query lower bound for distinguishing nonisomorphic binary-representable matroids from rank oracles without a supplied representation.
results.result: Polynomial-query reconstruction from rank oracles and a near-quadratic deterministic comparison lower bound.

results.title: Cycle index of code permutation automorphisms
results.question: Given a code and generators of its permutation automorphism group, obtain a polynomial-delay computation of all nonzero cycle-index coefficients or prove output-sensitive hardness.
results.result: Cycle-index listing is #P-hard for supplied full binary-code groups even with polynomially many possible signatures.

results.title: Stable equivalence of nested code chains
results.question: Determine the complexity of finding one monomial map carrying an arbitrary input flag C1⊆⋯⊆Cr to another such flag, with r varying and no separate relabeling at different levels.
results.result: One ordinary monomial-equivalence instance captures a variable-length simultaneous code flag.

results.title: Monomial code equivalence with prescribed multiplier product
results.question: For even q or sufficiently large odd q, determine whether prescribed product of coordinate multipliers changes the computational degree of monomial equivalence under reduction to ordinary LEP.
results.result: Prescribed multiplier product and ordinary LEP are deterministic polynomial-time Turing equivalent.

results.title: Prime-order generators of code automorphism groups
results.question: Decide whether the permutation automorphism group of a supplied code is generated by elements of some given prime order, with the generating group itself supplied as auxiliary input if needed.
results.result: Involution generation of a binary code's full permutation automorphism group is NP-complete even with generators supplied.

results.title: Minimum permutation-equivalent extension of codes
results.question: Given generator matrices, find the smallest number of linear parity coordinates that must be adjoined to each to create equivalent extended codes under a permutation allowed to mix original and new coordinates.
results.result: Minimum appended columns reduce to a maximal multiset overlap, and the threshold is NP-complete.

results.title: Minimum-domain extension of a subgroup action
results.question: Determine the smallest number of new points that must be adjoined to a prescribed M-set so that it embeds M-equivariantly into the restriction of some faithful G-set. Develop a compact-input algorithm or hardness classification.
results.result: Faithful extension has NP-complete zero augmentation and NP-hard gap zero versus at least 8L.

results.title: Sparse-input verification of group table validity
results.question: In an oracle model permitting bit queries to a claimed table with deterministic encodings of labels, determine the certificate complexity for associativity when Latin-square validity is promised.
results.result: A Latin-square promise still permits quadratic times logarithmic worst-case bit certificates and randomized query lower bounds.

results.title: Approximate permutational conjugacy under small support modification
results.question: Determine complexity of minimizing the number of points that must be omitted as invariant singleton orbits before two compact intransitive actions become conjugate, with omitted orbits chosen by the algorithm.
results.result: Deleting globally fixed points gives the exact singleton-deletion optimum and a conjugacy classification.

results.title: Cross-degree orbit equivalence after invariant duplication
results.question: Given two different-degree actions, determine the minimum addition of copies of already occurring orbits needed so that the enlarged action groups are permutationally isomorphic, in output-sensitive bit time.
results.result: Minimum duplication of existing orbits is NP-complete even for elementary abelian binary actions with orbits of size at most two.

results.title: Stabilizers along degeneration paths
results.question: Can the stabilizer jump loci in polynomial orbit closures be computed with complexity polynomial in succinct input size?
results.result: Polynomial-size circuit equations for all stabilizer dimension jumps, PIT-complete membership, and exponentially large explicit listings.

results.title: Efficient symmetrization across large group actions
results.question: Give an example of polynomial-size rational IPS derivations that cannot be symmetrized to polynomial-size circuit IPS under an explicit growing linear group of axiom symmetries, or characterize a broad sufficient condition.
results.result: Polynomial orbit-span dimension suffices for small invariant rational IPS certificates.

results.title: Inheritance of TI proof size under low-rank perturbations
results.question: Determine whether polynomial-size ordinary PC nonisomorphism certificates persist under a bounded number of explicitly supplied rank-one perturbations that preserve the unknown pair's geometric nonisomorphism.
results.result: Exponential ordinary TI monomial-size lower bound in side length, with a single rank-one change from easy to hard.

results.title: Degree-efficient simulation of linear IPS by symmetric proofs
results.question: If a finite-field system invariant under a large permutation group has a degree-d linear IPS refutation with polynomial size, find general conditions under which it has a degree-O(d) symmetric certificate with only polynomial growth.
results.result: Polynomial-index relative averaging preserves size and degree with syntactic symmetry even in modular characteristic.

results.title: Linear-depth tradeoffs for division-free resultant circuits
results.question: Give quantitative depth/size/degree tradeoffs for computing the multivariate resultant from the coefficient blocks using division-free arithmetic circuits, measured in n and the Macaulay input size.
results.result: Division-free resultant circuits of quadratic-log depth in Macaulay size and exact syntactic output degree.

results.title: Polynomial-degree orbit-sum separation for graph points
results.question: Determine the least degree d(n) such that graph-subpattern orbit sums of degree at most d(n) separate all Boolean adjacency-matrix orbits, with a nontrivial polynomial bound or lower bound.
results.result: Linear lower and O(n log n) upper bounds for separating Boolean graph orbits by orbit-sum degree.

results.title: Quantitative separating graphs for bounded-width targets
results.question: For n-vertex targets of rank width k, bound the smallest homomorphism-test graph distinguishing nonisomorphic targets, with an effective construction.
results.result: Smallest homomorphism separator has worst-case linear order already at rank width one.

results.title: Efficient finite homomorphism fingerprints for coherent graphs
results.question: Construct polynomially many polynomial-bit homomorphism counts sufficient for every graph in a recognized bounded-residual-algebra class.
results.result: Polynomial homomorphism fingerprints and reconstruction on each fixed bounded-adjacency-rank class.

results.title: Sharp exponential rate of real one-orbit ambiguity
results.question: For each d, bound the maximum number of isomorphism types of finite groups with faithful actions on R^d sharing one generic numerical Gram graph, uniformly in orbit size. In particular, is it bounded by exp(O(d))?
results.result: At most two choices per four-dimensional quaternionic isotype, giving an exponential worst-case bound.

results.title: One quaternionic summand and abstract ambiguity
results.question: Can a generic numerical orbit Gram graph fail to determine a finite group if the true representation has only one inequivalent four-dimensional quaternionic irreducible type?
results.result: A generic numerical orbit Gram graph with one quaternionic isotype determines the abstract group.

results.title: Exact recovery from noisy two-orbit data
results.question: Prove a sharp separation-dependent radius under which a deterministic algorithm recovers the regular multiplication law from an entrywise-perturbed joint Gram matrix of two generic real orbits.
results.result: Half the smallest cross-label separation is the sharp universal entrywise noise radius.

results.title: Partial cross-orbit observations
results.question: Determine how many exact cross-orbit inner products, chosen adaptively from two unlabeled generic real orbits, suffice to recover the acting group in the worst case as a function of orbit cardinality.
results.result: At most 6n−1 adaptive cross-orbit entries suffice for regular multiplication recovery.
